clog-1: Ruwan banɗaki baya tafiya ko kaɗan kuma yana ambaliya
clog-2: Wani abu (sharan goge baki, buroshin hakori, marfi) ya faɗa cikin masai
clog-3: Kwanon wanke-wanke yana wari kuma ruwa na taruwa
clog-4: Ruwa na ambaliya daga bututun ƙarƙashin kwanon wanke-wanke ko magudanar ƙasa
clog-5: Magudanar ruwan banɗaki ta toshe da gashi kuma tana ambaliya
clog-6: Magudanar ɗakin wanki ko baranda na dawo da kumfa da ruwa
clog-7: Babban bututun kwararar kashin gini ko ramin magudana ya toshe
clog-8: Ana buƙatar binciken bututu da kyamarar endoscope
clog-9: Ana buƙatar wanke bututu da matsin ruwa mai ƙarfi
clog-10: Matsalar bututun haɗin tankin kashi da dawowar ruwa
clog-11: Man girki ya toshe bututun magudanar na'urar niƙa abinci
clog-12: Wanke tarkon maiko na gidan abinci da buɗe bututu
leak-1: Ruwa na ɗigowa ko jika silin ko bangon ƙasa
leak-2: Mitar ruwa tana juyawa ko da ba a amfani da ruwa
leak-3: Fentin bango, kasan katako, ko kafet yana da laima tare da ƙwayoyin burodin dare
leak-4: Gabar famfo tana ɗigar ruwa ba kakkautawa
leak-5: Ƙasan bayan gida ko kayan tankin ruwa suna ɗigar ruwa
leak-6: Bututun ruwa ya fashe ko mitar ruwa ta daskare saboda sanyin hunturu
leak-7: Ruwa mai tsatsa ja ko laka na fitowa daga famfo
leak-8: Bututun injin ɗumi ko bawul ɗin rarraba ɗumi na zubar da ruwa
leak-9: Ruwan sama na shigowa ta tsagewar bango ko kewayen tagogi
leak-10: Ana buƙatar na'urar gano ɗigar ruwa ta hanyar sauti ko gas mai zurfi
leak-11: Matsin ruwa yayi ƙasa da yawa, ana buƙatar saka famfon ƙara ƙarfi
leak-12: Sauya tsofaffin bututu gaba ɗaya da hana ruwa shiga kasan banɗaki
bl-1: Wutar injin ɗumi na kunne, amma ɗakin baya ɗumi ko kaɗan
bl-2: Babu ruwan zafi lokacin wanka, ruwan sanyi kawai ke fitowa
bl-3: Lambar kuskure tana kyaftawa a kan ma'aunin zafin ɗaki
bl-4: Ruwa na ɗigowa daga cikin tukunyar dumama ruwa ko bututun ƙasa
bl-5: Ƙara mai ƙarfi ko ƙarar duka lokacin da tukunyar dumama ta tashi
bl-6: Warin gas ko hayaƙin bututun hayaki na shiga cikin ɗaki
bl-7: Matsalar famfon kewayawa; ana jin motsin ruwa amma babu ɗumi
bl-8: Ana buƙatar kiyasin kuɗi don sabuwar tukunyar gas mai tsimin makamashi
bl-9: Ma'aunin zafin kowane ɗaki ya lalace ko na'urar buɗe bawul ba ta aiki
bl-10: Ana buƙatar wanke bututun ɗumama (cire tsatsa) da fitar da iska
bl-11: Duba da gyaran tukunyar dumama mai amfani da mai / wutar lantarki / gawayi
bl-12: Narke kankara a bututun dumama da sake sanya abin kariya daga sanyi
clean-1: Shara da goge-goge kafin tarewa don ɗaki ɗaya/babban ɗaki (Cikakken kashe ƙwayoyin cuta)
clean-2: Cikakken wanke maikon murhu/abin shaƙar hayaki da datti mai tauri a sink
clean-3: Wanke naman gwari a maɗaurin fale-falen banɗaki, kashin ruwa da tsaftace bayan gida sosai
clean-4: Goge ƙurar jikin tagogi, ragar sauro da wanke gilashin ciki da waje
clean-5: Baza cikin firiji a wanke da tururin zafi don kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da cire wari
clean-6: Baza na'urar sanyaya ɗaki don wanke matatar iska da fuka-fukan sanyi masu naman gwari
clean-7: Baza gangar injin wanki don wanke ta sosai, kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da cire ƙazanta
clean-8: Goge daben ɗaki da injin wanke ƙasa, cire tabo da shafa kakin kariya
clean-9: Fitar da ƙananan ƙwari daga katifa / kujerar yadi da wankewa da ruwa sosai
clean-10: Tsaftace ɗakin da aka tara bola/shara sosai (Zubar da kaya masu yawa da cire wari)
clean-11: Shara bayan kammala gini (Goge ƙurar siminti da fentin da ya zuba)
clean-12: Cire gashin dabbobi/warin kashi da feshin maganin ƙamshi mai kare muhalli
h-1: Ɗaki ɗaya mai sauƙin kuɗi da aminci tare da ajiya mai sauƙi ta KRW miliyan 1 zuwa 3
h-2: Gidan da za a iya yin hayarsa ga masu katin zama na baƙi da takardar izinin zama ta doka
h-3: Kayan aiki cikakke (injin wanki, firiji, A/C, murhu/hobs na shiga ciki)
h-4: Yarjejeniyar gajeren lokaci (wata 3 zuwa 6) ɗakin studio/gosiwon
h-5: Gida mai ɗakuna biyu ko uku don zama tare da abokan aiki/iyali
h-6: Tsakanin minti 5 na tafiya zuwa tashar jirgin ƙasa ko motar bas
h-7: Kudin kula da gida da na amfani masu sauƙi kuma a bayyane
h-8: Wurin ajiye motoci da lif a cikin sabon gini na zamani
h-9: Masaukin da aka yarda da dabbobin gida (karnuka, kuliyoyi)
h-10: Mika hayar wuri da wuri & taimakon karɓo kuɗin ajiya (deposit)
bank-1: Rakiya don buɗe asusun banki tare da ARC / Fasfo
bank-2: Neman katin zare kuɗi (debit card) mai aikin sufuri na T-money
bank-3: Saita bankin wayar hannu, takardar shaidar dijital & OTP
bank-4: Ƙara iyakar tura kuɗi zuwa ƙasashen waje & rajistar asusun da za a tura wa
bank-5: Sake fitar da littafin banki/kati da ya ɓace & buga bayanan hada-hadar kuɗi
bank-6: Gyara kuskuren kalmar sirri sau 5 & buɗe asusun da aka toshe
bank-7: Keɓance asusun karɓar albashi & saita cire kuɗi kai tsaye (direct debit)
bank-8: Duba cancantar katin kiredit na baƙi & taimakon shirya takardu
insur-1: Duba cancantar Inshorar Lafiya ta Ƙasa & rakiya don yin rajista
insur-2: Inshorar wajibi ga ma'aikata baƙi (garantin tashi / haɗari)
insur-3: Shawara kan inshorar kuɗin magani na kashin kai & ɗaukar nauyin kwanciya asibiti
insur-4: Kwatanta & yin inshorar wajibi da cikakkiyar inshora ta mota / babur
insur-5: Jagorar neman biyan kuɗin inshora & fassarar takardun asibiti
insur-6: Daidaita inshora saboda canjin biza & neman mayar da kuɗin sokewa
insur-7: Shawarwari kan tsarin inshorar haƙori, ciwon daji & manyan tiyata
insur-8: Bincike & karɓar kuɗin inshora da ba a karɓa ba kafin komawa gida ƙasa ta asali
job-1: Masana'antu / Aikin samarwa a masana'anta & haɗa kaya (akwai masauki)
job-2: Mataimakin kicin na gidan abinci / Mai ba da abinci / Mai dafa abinci (ana maraba da 'yan waje)
job-3: Gine-gine / Cikin gida: aikin katako, ƙarfe, kafinta, lantarki da aikin famfo
job-4: Cinikayya / Ma'ajiyar kaya: shigarwa da fitarwa, tuki motar ɗaukar kaya da tattara kaya
job-5: Fassara / Gudanar da ofis / Kwararren tallace-tallace na duniya
job-6: Binciken kwangilar aiki (albashi, sa'o'in aiki, inshorar zamantakewa 4 na asali)
job-7: Albashin da ba a biya ba, kudin sallama da rakiya don shawarar shari'a kan rikicin aiki
job-8: Ga Masu Ɗaukar Ma'aikata: Ɗaukar kwararrun ma'aikatan waje masu aiki da izini na doka
hosp-1: Yin rajistar ganin likita da shiga babban asibiti ko asibitin jami'a
hosp-2: Lalurar hakori, maganin jijiyar hakori, cire hakori da rakiya tare da fassara
hosp-3: Kashin da ya karye, ciwon baya, da fassara don motsa jiki na magani (physiotherapy)
hosp-4: Maganin ciki / Kunne, Hanci da Maƙogwaro: mura, gudawa, da fassarar binciken ciki da hanji (endoscopy)
hosp-5: Duba lafiyar mata (OB-GYN) / Lafiyar mafitsara da fassarar shawarwarin sirri da likita
hosp-6: Bayanin sakamakon gwajin lafiya na ƙasa a cikin yaren asali
hosp-7: Rakiya da taimako zuwa ɗakin gaggawa (ER) na dare ko ranakun hutu
hosp-8: Yadda ake shan magungunan asibiti, kiyayewa da umarnin magani a kantin magani
mob-1: Kunna layin waya (USIM) mai sauƙin kuɗi ga baƙi tare da tabbatar da asali cikakke
mob-2: Sanya kudi a layin SIM na biya-ka-yi da tsare-tsaren intanet marar iyaka
mob-3: Babban kamfanonin sadarwa (SKT/KT/LGU+): sabon rajista da sauya sabuwar wayar zamani
mob-4: Sanya intanet mai saurin gaske na fiber da Wi-Fi na Giga a ɗaki ko gida
mob-5: Bude layin da aka dakatar saboda bashi, sauya sunan mai layi da canja kamfani da lamba (MNP)
mob-6: Saita manhajar tantance asali ta PASS da taimakon tantancewa ta wayar salula
mob-7: Fasasshen allon waya, canza baturi da rakiya zuwa cibiyar gyara ta hukuma
mob-8: Manhajojin kiran ƙasashen waje masu rahusa da siyan katin intanet na gaba
